## About
Cabrales Auto Repair is a family owned and operated shop on S Carondolet Ave in Chicago, and the owner is on site. We work on all major car brands, from routine oil changes and tune-ups to the repairs that come with a rattling muffler, grinding brakes or an engine that won't start.
We try to turn every repair around quickly so you can get back on the road safely. When a job takes longer, there's a clean waiting room with hot coffee, cold drinks and snacks.
Customers have rated us 4.5 from 106 Google reviews, and many of them mention fair pricing and being told the cost before any work starts.

## Services
- Grinding brakes: If your brakes are grinding, bring the car in and we'll take care of it.
- Engine running rough: If your engine is running rough, we're happy to track down the problem and fix it.
- Check engine light and emissions: We help get your check engine light sorted out so you can pass your emissions test.
- Rattling mufflers: A muffler that rattles is one of the everyday problems we fix.
- Heating and cooling: Thermostats, water pumps, radiators, heater cores, hoses and belts.
- Shocks and struts: Undercar work including shocks, struts, chassis and driveline.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday or Sunday?
A: No, we're closed Saturday and Sunday. We're open Monday through Friday.

Q: Do you offer lower cost parts?
A: Yes. Customers asked, so along with our top of the line parts we now offer an economy line. Just ask about it when you stop by.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We service all major car brands.
